newsitem.title: USA: INTEGRATED Q2 EPS SOARS AMID HIGHER MARGINS.
newsitem.headline: INTEGRATED Q2 EPS SOARS AMID HIGHER MARGINS.

text.p: Integrated Brands Inc Wednesday attributed its nine-fold increase in second-quarter earnings to product sales with higher gross profits, improved store operations and lower product introductory expenses.
The distributor of frozen desserts reported a net income of $1.8 million, or $0.18 a share, in the quarter ended June 28, compared with a $200,000 net, or $0.02 a share, last year.
Integrated said its improved product sales mix reflected sales of newly introduced Tropicana prepackaged frozen dessert novelties.

Revenues, however, decreased to $16 million from $16.6 million over the same period, which the company attributed to cooler-than-normal weather affecting sales of existing prepackaged frozen desserts.
The company's stock traded at 1 Wednesday morning, up 9/64.
